title: A compulsory visit
text:
Wonderful royal palace we stayed in February 2024 the cost of the ticket is 7€ derisory cost compared to the amount of beautiful things to see and the history contained.
The Almudaina was the seat of the independent kingdom of Mallorca during the monarchy of James II, Sancho I and James III, until its annexation, at the time of Pedro IV, to the Crown of Aragon. The current castle is the result of the renovation of the Muslim fortress begun in 1281. title: Best use of time to learn and enjoy
text: Best tour ever! Guide spoke clear English, was kind, smart and funny. Very educational. Would always recommend especially the castle
author: 941dg

title: Great sightseeing tour in Seville to see major monuments & familiarise yourself with the city!
text: Melissa was a great guide and we really enjoyed the sightseeing trip. We would definitely recommend it. Melissa told us a lot of interesting information about the history and  culture of Seville  and took us to some really cool places.
author: wendy_F

title: Seville
text: The Alcazar and Cathedral are must see stops in Seville. Our tour guide was fabulous. It’s worth having a guide as they share a lot of information.
author: Marty_C

title: Our guide, Melissa, was...
text: Our guide, Melissa, was great! She was knowledgeable, personable and fun. She explained the history of each place and also included cultural elements, such as her flamenco dance with a street guitarist. Her positive and playful personality made the tour very enjoyable for the adults and children in my group.
author: Elaine_S

title: The "Spicer" Review
text: Our tour of the palace with our tour guide, Carlos was funny and extremely interesting. Carlos was very knowledgeable and attentive to the tour group and individuals. We learnt a lot and my wife and daughter thoroughly enjoyed the experience. Thank you Carlos - it was a pleasure to have met you.
author: Robin S

title: A must see in Sevilla, Spain
text:
We liked the Royal Palaces, and the Cathedral very much. And our guide Jose Antonio ( I think that his last name)
was very knowledgeable of the tour and funny too. I would very highly recommended this tour. 👍👍👍
author: Vu_P

title: The best way to see Seville!
text: Our experience was fantastic! We had 2 different guides, one for the first part and another for the second part. Both of them were friendly and very knowledgeable. I only wish we could have spent even more time with our second guide. She did a great job! I highly recommend this tour!
author: cdf123

title: Very interesting visit
text: A visit to the main buildings with a very interesting guide, we could have a glimpse of these wonders that punctuate the city! All in a good mood and with humor.
author: nicole d

title: City of Jewels
text: Seville. .a city full of jewels. I only stayed there 2 days and I can't wait to go back to learn more about my visit. I got to see the Royal Alcazar Palace and experience the magic of a thousand and one nights
